p: my prayer: The earnestness of his prayer declares the vehemency of his grief in so much as he is compelled to burst out into cries.
voice of the enemy: For the threatenings of Saul and his adherents.
they cast iniquity upon me: They have defamed me as a wicked person, or they have imagined my destruction.
overwhelmed me: There was no part of him that was not astonished with extreme fear.
fly away: Fear had driven him to so great distress, that he wished to be hid in some wilderness, and to be banished from that kingdom which God had promised that he should enjoy.
from the windy storm and tempest: From the cruel rage and tyranny of Saul.
divide their tongues: As in the confusion of Babylon when the wicked conspired against God.
mischief also and sorrow are in: All laws and good orders are broken and only vice and dissolution reigns under Saul.
enemy that reproached me: If my open enemy had sought by hurt, I could better have avoided him.
equal: Who was not only joined to me in friendship and counsel in worldly matters, but also in religion.
go down quick into hell: As Korah, Dathan and Abiram.
and cry aloud: Which signifies a servants mind and sure trust to obtain his portion, which made him earnest at all times in prayer.
many with me: Even the angels of God fought on my side against my enemies, 2Ki 6:16.
have no changes: But their prosperous estate still continues.
hath put forth his hands against: I did not provoke him but was as at peace with him, yet he made war against me.
never suffer the righteous to be: Though for their bettering and trial, he permits them to slip for a time.
half their days: Though they sometimes live longer, yet their life is cursed by God, unquiet, and worse than any death.
